name: io.github.PGHQdev/openscreenshot
title: OpenScreenShot
description: Capture website screenshots (viewport or full page) with local Chrome, or on OpenScreenShot Cloud.

environmentVariables.name: CHROME_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to a Chrome, Chromium, or Edge executable. Leave unset to auto-detect.

environmentVariables.name: OPENSCREENSHOT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for OpenScreenShot Cloud, used with cloud: true. Not needed for local captures.

environmentVariables.name: OPENSCREENSHOT_CLOUD_URL
environmentVariables.description: OpenScreenShot Cloud base URL for cloud: true. Defaults to https://cloud.openscreenshot.app.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer osc_live_… API key from openscreenshot auth login or the Cloud dashboard
